title: Han Seeker
caption: Han Seeker (V)
game_text: Use 1 Force to deploy to an unoccupied site. Deploys and moves like an Undercover spy. If present with {permanent-weapon} Han or a smuggler of ability < 3, this weapon and that character are lost (“all cards” situation).
lore: Military version of a ‘remote.’ Programmed to stalk specific targets or secondary targets. Heat and light sensors track with fatal accuracy. Can stow away on starships.
copyright: TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Non-unique (no dot). Inline grey square with a green-bladed lightsaber before 'Han' → {permanent-weapon} per the run's convention (inline lightsaber square = warrior icon; i.e. 'a warrior Han'). Curly double quotes around “all cards”. A small brown sphere is printed in the middle of the bottom strip between the caption and the number (sheet artifact, not transcribed). Lore corrected from scan: ‘remote.’ in curly single quotes (wiki straight quotes). Base scan 745 px (Premiere-D-hanseeker.gif) carries a 'D-E1' label — top half is the printed face; copyright line legible: 1995. No 350 archive face listed. Modern remake is Block-era only (VB1-D-hanseeker-pre.gif, 348×490) — used as modern.
